overview: Storage holds as much as you can throw at it: chests, barrels, ender chests, shulker boxes and your own inventory stack a single item into the millions.
Hoppers, droppers, furnaces and everything else automation touches keep vanilla's 64, so sorters and comparator clocks work exactly as they did.

1.0.2: Bundles hold up to 9 kinds of item with 99 of each, and a bundle carrying more than that from an older world is split into readable portions when you join.
1.0.1: Bundles and shulker boxes keep vanilla's stacking, so two of them never end up sharing one set of contents, and eating from a huge stack shows the food rather than a missing texture.
Large counts are drawn short, 12k or 3.4m, by Pandorical on the client.
1.0.0: The first release: unlimited stacking in storage, vanilla stacks kept everywhere redstone reads them, and comparators still give a signal out of a container holding millions.
